name: MSE 5098
title: Variable Topics in Materials Science and Engineering
description: Advanced or specialized topics in materials science, engineering and/or technology. A maximum of three credits can count towards the applicable MSE graduate course credit requirements for M.S. Plan A, M.S. Plan B, M.Eng. or Ph.D. degrees. May be repeated for a total of 3 credits.
requirement_description: Departmental consent required; may be repeated with a change in topic.
